description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

Your brain grows to monstrous proportions to house a massive intellect. You gain +20 Intelligence and +10 Initiative. Your cranium is forced to expand as well in order to house your new, enormous brain. Roll 1d10. On 1-9 your head doubles in size, giving you an almost childlike anatomy. This makes your head an easier target, and any Hit Location Rolls for Arms or Body that are doubles strike your Head instead. You also receive a -1d10 modifier to your Agility since you are so unbalanced. On a 10 all the same things as the previous results happen, but your skull cant keep up with your brain and cracks open, exposing your brain. Any hits to the head gain the Damaging Quality even if you are wearing a helmet (that will have to be custom made). If you're not protected by a helmet, a called shot will automatically be a Critical Wound. You can only gain this mutation once.
